projects.name: Minecraft Mod Manager
projects.description: Inspired by package managers like apt and npm, Minecraft Mod Manager is a tool to download, update, and manage mods for your Minecraft server using the Modrinth and CursgeForge APIs.
projects.alt: Console log of a sample use of the program.

projects.name: YouTube Scroll To Watched
projects.description: A browser extension that adds a one-click button to YouTube's Subscriptions feed and scrolls directly to the most recently watched video. Designed for Firefox and published on the Firefox Add‑On store.

projects.name: Foptimum
projects.description: Foptimum is a lightweight, dockerized app to monitor your internet speed and uptime so you can keep your ISP accountable. Foptimum exports its data to Prometheus so it can easily be visualized with a tool like Grafana. Currently has 6200+ pulls from Dockerhub and is listed on the unRAID app store.
projects.alt: Example metrics generated by Foptimum and displayed in Grafana.
